subject: planner: hide read-write fields of PlanCacheValue for safety (#57759)
summary: Diff is a refactor/safety hardening of Instance Plan Cache runtime stats: PlanCacheValue’s runtime counters become unexported and are accessed via atomic `UpdateRuntimeInfo()` / `RuntimeInfo()`, and `pkg/executor/infoschema_reader.go:setDataFromPlanCache` switches from direct atomic loads to the accessor. Planner-side changes are limited to field renames (`StmtHints`, `ParamTypes`) in plan cache lookup/matching paths. Reviewed the minimal affected callers (infoschema plan-cache view + plan-cache lookup/adjust path + runtime-info update path) and scanned later history up to `upstream/master` for the touched files; no remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, privilege, or concurrency issues attributable to this commit.
